title: MGMT · Electric Feel
description: A night forest glows with stage lanterns, patterned dancers and a bright moon over the clearing.

performance.lyrics: All along the western front, people line up to receive. Ah got the power in her hand, to shock you like you won't believe. So hot in the Amazon With the voltage running through her skin Standing there with nothing but She gonna teach me how to swim said, boogah It shocked me like a magic ear, baby girl turned out through electric fear, said boo girl shocked me like an electric ear, baby girl It turned out through electric fear All along the eastern shore That's just that gets in the sea This is what the world is for, making electricity You can feel it in your mind, or you can do it all the time Can I get the energy to run, you are my electric girl said, boo girl, shock me like an electric peel Baby girl, tell me I want you to let did you fear? said boom, you know! It shocked me like an electric heel, baby girl Turn up with your electric heel Ah Ah Ah Do what you feel now He likes to feel now, he likes to feel now Ah Ah dim now do what feel
